name: Tom kho
summary: Tôm khô Rạch Gốc is dried shrimp from the mangrove, a collective trademark of the cape. Eat it with rice or carry a bag home.
origin: Rạch Gốc. Tôm khô Rạch Gốc is a collective trademark, and dried shrimp and dried fish are on the Cà Mau gift list.
howToEat: Eat it with rice, or carry a bag home.
where: Rạch Gốc, and the Cà Mau city market.
seoTitle: Tom kho — dried shrimp from Ca Mau
seoDescription: Tôm khô Rạch Gốc is dried mangrove shrimp, a collective trademark of the Cà Mau cape. Eat it with rice or carry a bag home.
